profile.entry_point_hint: api/main.py serves as the orchestrator API gateway; agents/profiler_agent/main.py, agents/tracer_agent/main.py, and agents/render_agent/main.py are independent microservice entry points that handle profiling, tracing, and rendering tasks respectively

gateway.name: AnalysisRouter
gateway.description: HTTP endpoint that orchestrates profiling, tracing, and rendering workflows for repository analysis.

gateway.name: GitHubRouter
gateway.description: HTTP endpoint for GitHub OAuth callbacks and repository listing.

gateway.name: ProfilerRouter
gateway.description: HTTP endpoint that exposes the profiler agent microservice for file tree extraction.

gateway.name: TracerRouter
gateway.description: HTTP endpoint that exposes the tracer agent microservice for static analysis and diagram generation.

gateway.name: RenderRouter
gateway.description: HTTP endpoint that exposes the render agent microservice for converting diagrams to visual formats.

services.name: AnalysisService
services.description: Orchestrates the analysis workflow by coordinating profiler, tracer, and render microservices.

services.name: GitHubService
services.description: Handles GitHub API interactions for OAuth and repository retrieval.

services.name: ProfilerService
services.description: Agent service that profiles repository structure and extracts layer hints using AI.

services.name: FileTreeService
services.description: Utility service for building and manipulating file tree structures.

services.name: GetFileTreeTool
services.description: Tool for extracting the complete file tree from a repository.

services.name: GetManifestFilesTool
services.description: Tool for identifying and extracting manifest files from the repository.

services.name: TracerService
services.description: Agent service that performs static analysis and generates architecture diagrams with AI-powered validation.

services.name: AstService
services.description: Service for parsing Python AST and extracting function signatures and import relationships.

services.name: CallGraphService
services.description: Service for building call graphs from Python source code.

services.name: EvidenceService
services.description: Service for building evidence bundles containing signatures, imports, and call edges.

services.name: FileFetchService
services.description: Service for fetching and managing source files from repositories.

services.name: GraphValidator
services.description: Service for validating architecture diagrams against evidence and rules.

services.name: CorrectionPromptBuilder
services.description: Service for building corrective prompts for AI-based graph validation.

services.name: BuildCallGraphTool
services.description: Tool for invoking call graph building during agent execution.

services.name: BuildEvidenceTool
services.description: Tool for invoking evidence bundle building during agent execution.

services.name: FetchLayerFilesTool
services.description: Tool for fetching layer files during agent execution.

services.name: GetDiagramTemplateTool
services.description: Tool for retrieving diagram templates during agent execution.

services.name: ParseAstTool
services.description: Tool for parsing AST during agent execution.

services.name: MermaidService
services.description: Service for rendering architecture diagrams to Mermaid format.

data.name: ProfileRequest
data.description: Model for profiler service requests containing repository paths and layer hints.

data.name: RenderRequest
data.description: Model for render service requests containing diagram specifications.

data.name: RenderResponse
data.description: Model for render service responses with rendered diagram data.

data.name: TracerResponse
data.description: Model for tracer service responses containing validated diagram specifications.

data.name: AnalyseRequest
data.description: Model for analysis API requests containing repository information and profiling data.

data.name: AnalyseResponse
data.description: Model for analysis API responses with profiling and tracing results.

data.name: GitHubCallbackRequest
data.description: Model for GitHub OAuth callback requests.

data.name: GitHubCallbackResponse
data.description: Model for GitHub OAuth callback responses.

data.name: RepositoryResponse
data.description: Model for individual GitHub repository information.

data.name: RepositoriesResponse
data.description: Model for GitHub repositories list response.

data.name: DiagramSpec
data.description: Shared model defining the complete architecture diagram specification with layers, edges, and external actors.

data.name: Component
data.description: Shared model representing a single architecture component with IO and children.

data.name: Edge
data.description: Shared model representing a directed edge between components.

data.name: ExternalActor
data.description: Shared model representing external systems like databases and APIs.

data.name: ComponentIO
data.description: Shared model defining input and output types for components.

data.name: LayerHints
data.description: Shared model containing directory mappings for architecture layer assignment.

data.name: ProfileResponse
data.description: Shared model for profiler responses containing extracted layer hints.

data.name: TracerRequest
data.description: Shared model for tracer service requests with layer hints and repository configuration.

data.name: ValidationResult
data.description: Model for validation results containing errors and attempted specifications.

external_actors.name: GitHub
external_actors.description: GitHub API for OAuth authentication and repository metadata retrieval.

external_actors.name: OpenAI
external_actors.description: LLM API for AI-powered code profiling, analysis, and diagram validation.
